acceptanceCriteria: The AFP-V0-013 driver's frozen argv and identity include the protected wrapper binary digest, and both selected and shadow runs exec declared packages under it.
A test shows a declared package whose test reads an undeclared repository path fails under the driver.
affected-plan-v0.md AFP-V0-013/023 record the binding; the AFP-V0-014 campaign refuses to start without it when a declaration exists.
body: AFP-V0-023 (V1-0246) lets .corvint/test-read-scopes.json take root-locating packages off the rule (d) floor, and full CI enforces each declaration by running the root go test with -exec .github/testconfine (Landlock). The AFP-V0-013 qualification driver's selected and shadow runs do not use the wrapper, so a declaration that is too narrow would pass a driver run and could under-select without detection. The spec requires this before any AFP-V0-014 campaign relies on a declaration. Found 2026-10-01 while delivering V1-0246.
title: affected driver: run selected and shadow runs under the testconfine wrapper
